# 1 Enoch Chapter 93 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 93:1 — Identification of source material

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Enoch began-to-recount from-the-books" | Literal; hyphenated |
| LOGOS | "Enoch began to recount from the books" | Formal; natural English |
| PNEUMA | "Enoch began to read from the books" | 'Read' is more accessible than 'recount' |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'recount.' The Ge'ez implies recounting/narrating from a written source, not merely reading. 'Recount' preserves the oral-proclamatory dimension.

---

## 93:3 — 'first end' / 'first catastrophe'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-first-end" | Literal; Ge'ez: qedami qes |
| LOGOS | "the first end" | Formal; preserves the term |
| PNEUMA | "the first catastrophe" | Interprets 'end' as destruction (the Flood) |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'the first end.' 'End' is the correct literal rendering and preserves the apocalyptic schema where each age has a marked terminus. PNEUMA's 'catastrophe' over-interprets.

---

## 93:4 — 'plant of righteous judgment'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-plant-of-righteous-judgment" | Literal compound |
| LOGOS | "the plant of righteous judgment" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "the plant of righteous judgment" | Agrees with LOGOS |

**SOPHIA:** All agree. LOGOS/PNEUMA rendering adopted. The 'plant' (tsemach / hatsatsa) metaphor for the chosen lineage is central to the Apocalypse of Weeks.

---

## 93:7 — 'a man shall ascend'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-man shall-ascend" | Literal; referent unnamed |
| LOGOS | "a man shall ascend" | Formal; preserves the anonymity |
| PNEUMA | "a man will be taken up" | 'Taken up' implies rapture (Elijah) |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'a man shall ascend.' The text deliberately leaves the referent anonymous; PNEUMA's 'taken up' adds interpretation. The anonymity is textually significant.

---

## 93:7 — 'house of dominion' burned / destroyed

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "house-of-dominion-shall-be-burned-with-fire" | Literal; compound |
| LOGOS | "house of dominion shall be burned with fire" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "house of dominion will be burned to the ground" | Adds 'to the ground' for emphasis |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. 'Burned to the ground' (PNEUMA) adds words absent from the Ge'ez.

---

## 93:8 — 'apostate generation' / 'faithless'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "an-apostate-generation-shall-arise" | Literal: mashta = apostate, perverse |
| LOGOS | "an apostate generation shall arise" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "a generation of apostates will arise" | Slight structural shift |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. All translators agree on 'apostate'; LOGOS structure is preferred. This is the generation of the author himself — the 7th week — which underlines the urgency of the entire Epistle.

---

## 93:9 — 'sevenfold instruction'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "sevenfold-instruction-concerning-all-His-creation" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "sevenfold instruction concerning all His creation" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "sevenfold instruction about all of God's creation" | 'About' for 'concerning'; 'God's' for 'His' |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. Both are equally acceptable; 'His creation' preserves the continuity of pronoun reference from the previous verse.

---

**Total disagreements this chapter: 6**
